correctness.rationale: The transition recurrence exactly reproduces Definition 2.1 of arXiv:2610.02506v1, including simultaneous spread before obligatory ignition when unburned vertices remain. Every nonterminal step burns a new vertex, so the complete finite-state closure at orders three to ten is an exhaustive finite proof. Independent BFS tuple and ternary integer DFS programs agree on all terminal sets; run-type and Hamming-radius computations check the full possible sets. For all orders at least ten, four alternating sign ignitions at indices 0, 2, 4, 6 are legal by the explicit distance/radius argument and force at least four sign-boundary edges.

value.rationale: The exact first order permitting four alternating colour domains is a motivated structural threshold for a newly studied two-colour propagation model, with a uniform witness for every larger cycle. The code through the threshold is fully classified (including four cyclic run types) and its exact Hamming radii resolve the corresponding balanced-signature plurality minima at these orders. The positive ten-cycle radius four contrasts with the prior ten-path radius three. This is not merely a single arbitrary experiment or a normalization check.
